certification_and_marking.certification_status: Mandatory Certification under State Legal Metrology Acts and Rules. Manufacturers must possess a valid license to manufacture, and each commercial measure must be physically verified, stamped, or lead-sealed by a State Legal Metrology Inspector to be legally sold or used for trade in India.

requirements.detail: Observed or calculated final test values, dimensional parameters, wall thicknesses, and volumetric capacities must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960. The decimal places retained should match that of the specified value in the standard.
Standardizes standard dipping cylindrical sizes: 1 litre, 500 ml, 200 ml, 100 ml, 50 ml, and 20 ml.
Standardizes standard pouring cylindrical sizes: 2 litres, 1 litre, 500 ml, 200 ml, 100 ml, 50 ml, and 20 ml.
Standardizes standard conical sizes: 20 litres, 10 litres, 5 litres, 2 litres, 1 litre, 500 ml, 200 ml, and 100 ml.
The body of the cylindrical measures must be manufactured as a single, seamless unit from aluminium sheet of specified wall thickness to eliminate leakage paths.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 1058 : 1993 (Reaffirmed 2024) is the primary national Indian Standard specification prescribing quality requirements, material properties, and nominal dimensions for commercial capacity measures (both cylindrical and conical types) used in legal trade transactions. Maintained under the Commercial Weights and Measures Sectional Committee (LM 06), the standard unifies metric volumetric measures—such as dipping cylindrical cups (10 ml–1L), pouring cylindrical cylinders (20 ml–2L), and conical containers (100 ml–20L)—to prevent short-measuring and guarantee consumer protection. It mandates seamless, single-piece aluminium body construction, specifies tight wall-thickness baselines (1.00 to 1.60 mm) and height-diameter proportions, and enforces rigid rounding protocols as per IS 2:1960 to support standardized verification and stamping by state weights and measures inspectors.
